# Rights Action

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RightsAction`](gmeow-RightsAction.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RightsAction>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of action a rights rule regulates — a VALUE, never a rule subclass. The set is open (ODRL's action vocabulary + CC REL); an action not among the seed individuals is a FRESH [`gmeow:RightsAction`](gmeow-RightsAction.md) individual carrying [rdfs:label.](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label.) Pointed at by [`gmeow:ruleAction`](../properties/gmeow-ruleAction.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RightsAction`](gmeow-RightsAction.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the regulated-action axis — the kind of act (reproduce, distribute, derive, attribute, …) a rule controls, referenced via [`gmeow:ruleAction`](../properties/gmeow-ruleAction.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid modelling an action as a rule subclass (actions are individuals, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid inventing a free-text action; reuse a seeded ODRL/CC REL value or mint a fresh individual.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:RightsAction`](gmeow-RightsAction.md) ([`gmeow:actionReproduce`](../individuals/gmeow-actionReproduce.md), [`gmeow:actionAttribute`](../individuals/gmeow-actionAttribute.md), …) from a rule's [`gmeow:ruleAction`](../properties/gmeow-ruleAction.md); when a needed action is missing, mint a new value individual with [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) and align it to ODRL by reference.

### Examples

- ex:actionMint a [`gmeow:RightsAction`](gmeow-RightsAction.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "mint"@en.
